# temps_ai_instance_limits (Resource)

AI gateway limits for the whole instance. Destroying the resource removes them.

Import with `ai_instance_limits`.

Required API key permissions: `ai_gateway:read`, `ai_gateway:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ai_instance_limits" "this" {
  max_requests_per_minute       = 1200
  max_cost_per_month_microcents = 50000000000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_cost_per_month_microcents` (Number) Spend per calendar month in millionths of a cent; unset means no limit.
- `max_requests_per_minute` (Number) Requests per minute; unset means no limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `ai_instance_limits`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_ai_instance_limits.this ai_instance_limits
```
